To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) bottom up and top-down attention mechanisms can be combined to improve the state of the art in image captioning; (2) this combined approach can also be used to improve the state-of-the-art in the visual question answering task; and (3) this combined approach is applicable in both image captioning and VQA tasks.

a combined bottom up top down attention mechanism, applied to the task of image captioning, achieves a new state of art in the task, and that the same approach applied to the task visual question answering achieves the first place result in the 2016 VQA Challenge.
the combination of bottom up and top-down attention mechanisms is effective and that it leads to state of the art performance on the image captioning and VQA tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (a) What is the best way to model attention in image captioning? (b) What is the role of bottom up and top-down attention mechanisms? and (c) What is the most effective way to combine the two?

the following questions: How can we combine bottom up and topdown mechanisms in a principled way? How can the bottom up mechanism be made efficient? Can the top down mechanism be simplified? How can we apply the approach to VQA and achieve state of the art results?
